# Causal Machine Learning and Policy Evaluation

> Estimate who benefits from a programme with machine learning, evaluate allocation rules offline before using them, and choose a rule under a budget and a fairness constraint that ends in the trial that would confirm it. SDAIA Academy course DS-402, version 2027.1.0, in English.

Each slide is a heading such as "#### [day1#slide-id] Title": cite slides by that id, and each citation is a link (slides/day1.html#slide-id). These files are what a trainee sees: no speaker notes and no answer keys.

## Course

- [Course page](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/index.md): overview, outcomes, schedule and labs; the page itself is https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/index.html
- [The whole course](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/llms-full.txt): every unit, session and slide in one file, about 20,226 tokens
- [Practice questions](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/practice.html): questions to check yourself, with feedback after each answer

## Slides

- [Day 1: Average effects with many confounders](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/day1.md): From three agency questions to an average effect estimated by double machine learning, with its overlap and its sensitivity to what the data lack; sessions: Estimands for allocation, Overlap first, Double machine learning, Nuisance models and hidden confounding; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/day1.html; about 5,493 tokens
- [Day 2: Who benefits](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/day2.md): Conditional effects by three methods on the randomised pilot, checked on held-out data before anyone is targeted; sessions: Meta-learners, Causal forests, Validating effects, Uplift for targeting; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/day2.html; about 4,166 tokens
- [Day 3: Evaluating rules before using them](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/day3.md): The value of current practice and of candidate rules from logged decisions, with the diagnostics that say when not to believe it; sessions: Logged decisions, Weighted and augmented estimators, Untrustworthy estimates, Reviewing an effects claim; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/day3.html; about 4,279 tokens
- [Day 4: Choosing and testing a policy](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/day4.md): A rule learned under one place per five seekers, audited by region, gender and disability, and the trial that would confirm it; sessions: Policy learning under a budget, Fair allocation, The confirmatory trial, Explaining a rule; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/day4.html; about 4,327 tokens
- [Capstone: Capstone: a policy evaluation and its defence](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/capstone.md): One brief, one constrained rule, its offline value, a subgroup audit and a trial plan, defended in 15 minutes; page: https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/slides/capstone.html; about 1,308 tokens

## Labs

- [Lab 1.1: Three estimands and a risk trap](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D1_1_estimands.ipynb): Day 1, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 1.2: Groups almost never offered](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D1_2_overlap.ipynb): Day 1, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 1.3: Double machine learning against regression](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D1_3_dml.ipynb): Day 1, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 1.4: Swap learners, bound a hidden confounder](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D1_4_sensitivity.ipynb): Day 1, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 2.1: S-, T- and X-learners on the pilot](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D2_1_metalearners.ipynb): Day 2, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 2.2: A causal forest and its drivers](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D2_2_causal_forest.ipynb): Day 2, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 2.3: Calibration and ranking per estimator](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D2_3_validate.ipynb): Day 2, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 2.4: Uplift, Qini and a threshold](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D2_4_qini.ipynb): Day 2, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 3.1: Current practice from the logs](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D3_1_logged.ipynb): Day 3, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 3.2: Three rules offline](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D3_2_offline.ipynb): Day 3, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 3.3: A rule resting on heavy weights](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D3_3_weights.ipynb): Day 3, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 3.4: Four seeded faults](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D3_4_review.ipynb): Day 3, Session 4, 25 min
- [Lab 4.1: A depth-two rule against the alternatives](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D4_1_policy_tree.ipynb): Day 4, Session 1, 25 min
- [Lab 4.2: Attributes, audit and a constraint](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D4_2_fairness.ipynb): Day 4, Session 2, 25 min
- [Lab 4.3: Size the trial](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D4_3_trial.ipynb): Day 4, Session 3, 25 min
- [Lab 4.4: One-page summary and the capstone brief](https://sdaiaacademy.github.io/ds-402/labs/D4_4_summary.ipynb): Day 4, Session 4, 25 min
